parameters.name: DbName
parameters.description:
The database name.

> Specify either **DbName** or **DbNames**. If both parameters are specified, **DbNames** takes priority over **DbName**.

parameters.name: DbNames
parameters.description:
The list of database names separated by commas (,). This parameter enables cross-database search and supports up to 10 databases.
> Specify either **DbName** or **DbNames**. If both parameters are specified, **DbNames** takes priority over **DbName**.

parameters.name: ImageUrl
parameters.description: The image URL. We recommend that you use an Object Storage Service (OSS) link in the Shanghai region. If the file is stored locally or in an OSS bucket outside the Shanghai region, see [File URL Processing](~~155645~~). The URL cannot exceed 1024 characters in length.

parameters.name: Limit
parameters.description: The maximum number of face search results returned for a single face list. Valid values: 1 to 100.

parameters.name: MaxFaceNum
parameters.description: The number of faces in the input image to search and compare. This parameter controls the number of face sample lists. Valid values: 1 to 10. Default value: 5.

parameters.name: QualityScoreThreshold
parameters.description: The quality score threshold. The system performs quality analysis on the face image. If the quality score is lower than this threshold, the face image quality does not meet the requirements and the comparison fails. Valid values: 0.0 to 100.0. A value of 0.0 or empty indicates that quality score evaluation is not performed.
